title: Sprint 6 - Aggregation Basics
description: Complete all MongoDB queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Count Total Tasks
tickets.description:
Find out exactly how many total tasks exist in the system.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos;
```
tasks: Find out exactly how many total tasks exist in the system.

tickets.title: SUM, MIN, MAX, AVG
tickets.description:
Find the total sum, minimum, maximum, and average of the `priority` field for all tasks.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT SUM(priority), MIN(priority), MAX(priority), AVG(priority) FROM todos;
```
tasks: Find the total sum, minimum, maximum, and average of the `priority` field for all tasks.
learning_objectives: Use the aggregation framework for basic statistics.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the $ sign on the field path "$priority".
hints: To aggregate all documents, group by _id: null.

tickets.title: Task Count by Status
tickets.description:
Create a report showing each `status` and the total number of tasks in that status.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM todos GROUP BY status;
```
tasks: Create a report showing each `status` and the total number of tasks in that status.
learning_objectives: Group documents by a field using the aggregation framework.
hints: Use the $group stage and count documents using { $sum: 1 }.

tickets.title: Overloaded Users
tickets.description:
Show the `user_id` and count of tasks only for users who have strictly more than 5 tasks.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks FROM todos GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;
```
tasks: Show the `user_id` and count of tasks only for users who have strictly more than 5 tasks.
common_mistakes: Placing the filter before the $group stage.
hints: The second stage should be a $match on total_tasks.
